mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, config_value, value_type, category, scope, description, default_value, validation_regex, is_sensitive, updated_by, updated_at, created_at FROM t_system_config ORDER BY category ASC, config_key ASC

SELECT id, config_key, config_value, value_type, category, scope, description, default_value, validation_regex, is_sensitive, updated_by, updated_at, created_at FROM t_system_config WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY config_key ASC

SELECT id, config_key, config_value, value_type, category, scope, description, default_value, validation_regex, is_sensitive, updated_by, updated_at, created_at FROM t_system_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_config_audit (config_key, old_value, new_value, action, operator_id, operator_email, client_ip, reason) VALUES (#{a.configKey}, #{a.oldValue}, #{a.newValue}, #{a.action}, #{a.operatorId}, #{a.operatorEmail}, #{a.clientIp}, #{a.reason})
